ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DEP] AS
BEGIN
---------------------------------------------EODACCOUNTBALANCE------------------------------------------------
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD AS (
-- EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date & TRAN_DATE_BAL
SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BDE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDE.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS BalanceAmount
	,BDE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BDE.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS PeriodMonthYear
	,NULL AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BDED.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA BDED
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE BDE 
	ON BDED.ACID = BDE.ACID 
	AND BDED.BANK_ID = BDE.BANK_ID 
	AND BDED.EOD_DATE = BDE.EOD_DATE
	AND BDE.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDE.ACID = BDG.ACID
	AND BDE.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

-- EOD Total Transaction Balance of Transaction Date & TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Transaction Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BDE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDE.TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS BalanceAmount
	,BDE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BDE.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS PeriodMonthYear
	,NULL AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BDED.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA BDED
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE BDE 
	ON BDED.ACID = BDE.ACID 
	AND BDED.BANK_ID = BDE.BANK_ID 
	AND BDED.EOD_DATE = BDE.EOD_DATE
	AND BDE.BANK_ID = BDED.BANK_ID
	AND BDE.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDE.ACID = BDG.ACID 
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

-- EOD Running Balance of Value Date & VALUE_DATE_BAL
SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Running Balance of Value Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BDE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDE.VALUE_DATE_BAL AS BalanceAmount
	,BDE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BDE.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS PeriodMonthYear
	,NULL AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BDED.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA BDED
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE BDE 
	ON BDED.ACID = BDE.ACID 
	AND BDED.BANK_ID = BDE.BANK_ID 
	AND BDED.EOD_DATE = BDE.EOD_DATE
	AND BDE.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDE.ACID = BDG.ACID 
	AND BDE.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

-- EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date & VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'EOD Total Transaction Balance of Value Date' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDE.EOD_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BDE.END_EOD_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDE.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS BalanceAmount
	,BDE.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BDE.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,NULL AS PeriodMonthYear
	,NULL AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDE.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BDED.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA BDED
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE BDE 
	ON BDED.ACID = BDE.ACID 
	AND BDED.BANK_ID = BDE.BANK_ID 
	AND BDED.EOD_DATE = BDE.EOD_DATE
	AND BDE.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDE.ACID = BDG.ACID 
	AND BDE.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD where CustomerAccountId is not null;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,PeriodStartDate ,PeriodEndDate ,BalanceAmount ,IsoCurrencyCode ,FinancialInstitutionId)) HASHROW
	,CustomerAccountId ,RECORD_STATUS
	, FinancialInstitutionId
	, PeriodBalanceTypeId
	, PeriodStartDate
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD 
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CustomerAccountId ,PeriodBalanceTypeId ,PeriodStartDate ,PeriodEndDate ,BalanceAmount ,IsoCurrencyCode ,FinancialInstitutionId)) HASHROW
	, CustomerAccountId
	, FinancialInstitutionId
	, PeriodBalanceTypeId
	, PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' and 	PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId,TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId) AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate,TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
	,CASE WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate 
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate)))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate in ('9999-12-31')


--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
	,SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,SRC.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
	,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate 



-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
	,PeriodBalanceTypeId AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
	,IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_EOD_DELTA;



---------------------------------------------TBL_MONTHLY_ADB------------------------------------------------


--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL AS (
-- Average Current Balance & AVE_CURR_BALANCE
SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'Average Current Balance' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDT.TRANDATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDT.AVE_CURR_BALANCE AS BalanceAmount
	,BDT.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BDT.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,BDT.MONTH_YEAR AS PeriodMonthYear
	,BDT.QUARTER_YEAR AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDT.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BDTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB_DELTA BDTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB BDT 
	ON BDTD.ACID = BDT.ACID 
	AND BDTD.BANK_ID = BDT.BANK_ID 
	--AND BDTD.TRANDATE = BDT.TRANDATE
	AND BDT.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDT.ACID = BDG.ACID 
	AND BDT.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

-- Average Clear Balance & AVE_CLR_BALANCE
SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'Average Clear Balance' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDT.TRANDATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDT.AVE_CLR_BALANCE AS BalanceAmount
	,BDT.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BDT.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,BDT.MONTH_YEAR AS PeriodMonthYear
	,BDT.QUARTER_YEAR AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,BDT.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BDTD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB_DELTA BDTD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB BDT 
	ON BDTD.ACID = BDT.ACID 
	AND BDTD.BANK_ID = BDT.BANK_ID 
	--AND BDTD.TRANDATE = BDT.TRANDATE
	AND BDT.ISLATEST = 1
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDT.ACID = BDG.ACID 
	AND BDT.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL where CustomerAccountId is not null;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate

)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId,TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId) AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodStartDate,TGT.PeriodStartDate) AS PeriodStartDate
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate 
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = convert(date, dateadd(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'


---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE

CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,PeriodMonthYear
,PeriodQuarterYear
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS BillingCycleId
,SRC.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.PeriodMonthYear AS PeriodMonthYear
,SRC.PeriodQuarterYear AS PeriodQuarterYear
,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate

INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance (

,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,PeriodMonthYear
,PeriodQuarterYear
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,PeriodMonthYear AS PeriodMonthYear

,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode

,0 AS WorkFlowId

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA;


END

FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate 
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate =  CONVERT(DATE,DATEADD(day,-1,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate))) 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND DELTA.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId AND SRC.PeriodStartDate = TGT.PeriodStartDate
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate in ('9999-12-31')
